name: @lanka-playgrounds/vue-spa
description: Atlas in Vue: a Vite single-page application, with single-file components and the same ViewModels every other host reads.

scripts.//dev: The application, against the API on port 4380. Start the server first.
scripts.//build:app: NOT `build`. `pnpm verify:build` is `pnpm -r run build` and it exists to check what is PUBLISHED; a bundler run in that chain would add a minute to every gate.
scripts.//typecheck: `vue-tsc`, not `tsc`: a single-file component is markup, script and style in one, and the TypeScript compiler cannot read one. A project that used `tsc` here would typecheck every file EXCEPT its components.
